real_s3.explanation: The unit responds to small dark, glossy, rounded objects such as beetles, spiders, ticks, ladybugs, acorns, buckeyes, coffee and espresso cups. Within these classes it prefers subjects in profile facing or pointing to the right, rather than to the left or toward or away from the camera. It is also somewhat more active when the subject sits fully inside the frame rather than cut off by an edge. Rows 1 and 4 (right-facing) are at the 97th percentile, and none of the similar units reach 95 there, so this direction preference is particular to this unit. Row 13 (fully inside the frame) is at 94 with low similar-unit values, which makes it a plausible extra.
